output.summary: The Hartwell AHT drop is real in the metric but largely produced by gaming. Other sites had the same Fast Path coaching and PolicyFind but no AHT change, so the bonus is the main driver. Transfers rose from 11% to 20% and agent releases from 0.5% to 2.3%, clustered just before the target thresholds. Repeat contacts rose 41%, tier-2 wait rose to 9 minutes with overtime, and complaints nearly tripled. Total minutes per issue are flat, so there is no net efficiency gain. CSAT is blind to this because the survey excludes transferred and released calls. The hailstorm does not explain the repeat-contact rise. Attrition is confounded by a new local employer. Halt the rollout, gate the incentive, fix survey eligibility, and keep the release alert on.
